merge_policy.sample_index: reset to original_manifest_index/full manifest index when available
merge_policy.baseline_scope_build: deduplicated by project/scope_key/module and class_rows recomputed on combined N=300
merge_policy.metrics: row-level concat of completed run metrics, then RQ/statistical artifacts recomputed on combined N
merge_policy.api_logs: row-level concat from root api_log.csv files; missing API rows remain absent when generation was blocked before GPT
merge_policy.generated_tests: copied into this combined run and manifest paths rewritten

prompt_protocol: AgoneTest base zero-shot from proposal; no java_language_rules.

fairness_policy.prompt: original AgoneTest zero-shot prompt from proposal
fairness_policy.sandbox_policy: one focal class per sandbox; only that generated test is installed and measured
fairness_policy.baseline_gate: all classes/scopes must pass clean baseline build and per-class sandbox prewarm readiness before generation starts
fairness_policy.failure_scoring: failed generated tests are compilation=0 and strict metrics=0
